method: Actual GLB ring vertices projected as VP × model × part × position, exactly matching the production vertex shader. Width is the range along the screen-space perpendicular to the projected local route tangent. Physical hose OD uses shell vertices independently matched at the same section, not a screenshot mask.
limitations: Geometric projected width is an upper bound on visible coloured fluid width; occlusion, Fresnel response, antialiasing and optical-density shader contrast can make the perceived core narrower.
No objective photorealism or readability score is inferred from these widths. Plate channels are not round physical pipes and have no claimed pipe OD.
Raw normalized tray radii are not millimetres. Projection includes the original non-uniform model scale.
